body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2025-08-08 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "We have to collect close to INR100 crores, which we believe collection should all happen in Q2 or early Q3, not beyond that" Metric: Collections. Target: INR 100 cr by ~Oct-25. Deadline: 2025-10-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: INR 75 cr still outstanding at 31-Dec-25; collected by Mar-26 ('not beyond that' missed by about two quarters).
